extraction.notes: Pass 1 full extraction from the converted text file under extraction rules 0.4 and themes 1.3. Read the table of contents (pages 2-3), the introduction (page 4), the whole of section 1.2 Main findings (pages 5-21, where each chapter is summarised with standard preparation and progress wording and recommendations), and every later section, reading in full the pages that the table of contents or a keyword screen (digital, electronic, e-, online, data, cyber, artificial intelligence, interoperab, broadband, identification, portal, ICT, IT system, internet, 5G, platform, web) showed to carry technology content, plus all of Chapter 2 (pages 62-63) and the legal migration passage of Chapter 24 (page 46). Chapter 2 appears twice: a summary under 1.2 (pages 11-12) and the full section (pages 62-63); both are extracted as separate items. Period covered taken from footnote 3 of the report (15 June 2023 to 1 September 2024) because the register field is empty. Text-file page numbers are printed page numbers plus one. Left out as outside the materiality test under rules 0.4 (R21, R22): ACCMIS and other court back-office systems, IFMIS and human resources management information systems, the digitalised surveillance procedure, Interpol and SIENA exchanges, cybercrime statistics and the cybercrime department, the unified register of bank accounts and the digital denar, the IPR enforcement data platform, the State Market Inspectorate's internal procedures, the integrated IT tax system and the excise movement controls, customs IT consolidation and upgrades, the customs paperless environment, intelligence system and data warehouse, intelligent transport and electronic freight information, IACS and LPIS interoperability, fisheries and pesticide data, the social assistance IT system, the 112 emergency number staffing, the flood incident platform, the consumer information web platform and websites used to publish information. Media content of Chapter 10 and freedom of expression (media regulator, public broadcaster, digital national media, online media) was treated as outside the technology theme, except net neutrality. The seasonal-worker agreements on page 63 were left out as concerning nationals' access to EU labour markets. Graph 12 on page 36 (data protection inspections, complaints and data breach declarations) was not extracted because the converted text separates the values from their labels. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
